about: Which licences the library takes in and in what order the resolver prefers them. The licence floor was settled by the creator on 2026-10-14 ("We can open up CC-By"): CC-BY is allowed with the asset's credit line written into the game. Changing the floor is an edit here, never code.

own.about: made by the kit, the creator or a build

permissive.about: the licence text travels with the file (the game's ATTRIBUTION and the pack's LICENSE.txt); OFL-1.1 is for fonts (a font is never sold on its own)

attribution.about: used only with the asset's credit line written into the game's credits

paid-maker.about: output of a paid generator on the creator's account: used only when the caller holds that account's key and the creator said yes
